priority.name: București
priority.finding: Two-page signed decision recovered; no current graphic annex. PMB legacy annex belongs to HCGMB 76/1993 and does not establish the monastic saint introduced in 2024. No independently approved municipal flag graphic recovered. Both nulls retained.

priority.name: Harghita
priority.finding: Final statutory blazon has four crosses and eight stars; December 2025 proposal has five crosses and twelve stars, so proposal rejected. Final graphic endpoint failed Node fetch, native PowerShell HTTP and Chromium (HTTP2 protocol error; HTTP1 empty response). Coat null retained. Selected flag is blue/gold with sun and moon; 2004 statute page63 instead describes white with alternating red/black triangular border under decision40/2002. This older text does not establish whether a later flag replaced it. No current flag-approval annex recovered: existing flag retained unconfirmed, independent of coat approval.

priority.name: Vrancea
priority.finding: Act description located: eagle, bull, frontal barrel with five grape bunches. UBB PDF contains only issue cover and pages15-16, not page10 graphic annex. Actual selected coat visually matches the major2026 blazon charges (eagle, silver bull and five grape bunches around the barrel); exact official annex comparison remains blocked. Existing coat and separate white flag with embedded arms retained without full certification. No demonstrated new version justifies replacement.

priority.name: Municipiul Chișinău
priority.finding: Both Atlas identities share CUATM0100 but remain distinct: osm-r1748490 is ADM8 beneath osm-r1691801 ADM4. Institutional large coat bytes exactly match local original. Eight-page use regulation linked from Ciocana recovered, visually read in full: sections1.3 and4.1 identify the municipal holder and the small form, section9.1 preserves statutory uses; no graphic annex in this PDF. Designer first-hand account, Dialogica3/2020 pp19-36, confirms large and small municipal coats plus flag. Full normative annex not recovered. Existing municipal assets retained; informative-symbol use documented separately; reproduction copyright remains unresolved.

priority.name: Orașul Chișinău
priority.act: Separate legal holder not independently established
priority.finding: Designer account identifies the old arms as the small MUNICIPAL coat, not proof of a second legal holder for the separate Atlas city identity. Actual selected city SVG depicts the large municipal coat with tower supporters, not a separate small city coat; both current flag images show the white/yellow municipal pattern. Existing plausible assignments retained unconfirmed under conservation principle; no automatic transfer from municipality.

priority.name: Câmpulung
priority.finding: Signed2013 local-proposal annex is a flag-like composition carrying a blue-field shield with upper black eagle; it is not the recovered national2015 annex. Current violet-field PNG conflicts with municipal blue-field description; alternative SVG lacks upper black eagle required by same description. National graphic annex not recovered. Neither disputed coat nor separately unconfirmed flag replaced; partial Lions Club credit prevents rights clearance.

priority.name: Tălmaciu
priority.finding: Commons describes before1918 while pixels contain modern-style municipal arms. Municipality January2021 newspaper documents selection procedure for a city flag, not proof current selected Commons file was approved. Period/re-adoption unresolved; flag retained DISPUTED, coat independent.
